title: The Willow Creek Drive-In Crossroads
setting: Set in the waning days of late summer in Willow Creek, a quiet rural town tucked between endless cornfields. The drive-in’s gravel lot is dotted with a handful of early-arriving cars, their windshield wipers flicking away fine mist, and the concession stand’s neon “POPCORN” sign sputters intermittently. The second-generation owner stands behind the ticket booth, staring at a formal offer letter from a local housing developer tucked in her back pocket.

characters.name: Jessa Mae Carver
characters.tendencies: She is the reserved second-generation owner of the drive-in, torn between accepting a lucrative housing developer offer and refinancing to honor her late father’s legacy
